text:
Mia Chen: Heads up — onboarding a regulated APAC customer based in Bangkok. They need private connectivity (PrivateLink-style) to our shared-models service + dedicated H100 capacity in ap-southeast-3 (or nearest AZ). Need guidance on quotas, egress IPs, and subnet sizing. cc @CloudOps

CloudOps Bot: Created ticket INF-APAC-4892 to track. Can you confirm expected scale and HA? Also which cloud (Azure/GCP/AWS)? We can submit quota requests once we have numbers.

Mia Chen: They prefer Azure but are open to GCP if capacity is better. Target: 24 H100 GPUs initially, spread across 3 AZs for HA. Prefer private control plane + PrivateLink to their VNet for model artifact access. Expect steady inference: ~200 reqs/s, occasional spikes to 600 reqs/s.

Sanjay Rao: Ok — for Azure we'll need: subscription quota increase for H100 (ND H100_v5 SKU), ENI/IP planning (each VM needs multiple IPs if we run 4 GPUs per host), and NAT gateway SNAT port headroom. SNAT exhaustion is the usual gotcha for high-concurrency inference. Suggest reserving an egress IP pool (8–16 IPs) and request increased SNAT ports from cloud support.

Sanjay Rao: Example ask to Azure support: ```
Please increase quota for ND H100_v5 in region southeast-3 to 24 GPUs (or corresponding VM count). Also request additional Public IP addresses for NAT gateway: 12. Increase outbound SNAT port limit for the subscription in region to support 600 concurrent connections (approx 65k ephemeral ports divided across NAT IPs) and subnet ENI quota for 20 VMs.
```

Leah Park: Budget check — rough monthly delta for 24 H100s (on-demand) + NAT egress: ~ $65k–$90k depending on reserved vs on-demand. If they commit to 12+ months, we can pursue reserved instances to shave ~25%. Also factor in PrivateLink data transfer costs and cross-subscription peering fees.

Omar Patel: For the PrivateLink piece, do they want us to host a Private Endpoint in their VNet or provide a Private Endpoint service on our side? If they host the endpoint to our service, we'll need a peering/connection from our shared-services hub (sharedServices-vnet) and update route table for the model artifacts subnet. If they want an endpoint to our service, we need to open a service connection and share service ID.

Mia Chen: They want our service exposed as a Private Endpoint in their VNet (customer-managed). So we'll register a PrivateLink service in our hub and they will create the endpoint. Please include route and NSG suggestions to lock down access to only their subnet.

CloudOps Bot: INF-APAC-4892 updated with requested items: H100 quota increase, 12 public IPs for NAT, SNAT port limit increase, ENI quota, and PrivateLink service creation. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-APAC-4892

Infra-Bot: Suggested subnet layout snippet for deployment: ```
# hub vnet (10.200.0.0/16)
shared-services-subnet: 10.200.0.0/24 (PrivateLink svc + load balancers)
model-hosts-subnet: 10.200.1.0/22 (hosts - plan for 5k IPs headroom)
nat-subnet: 10.200.5.0/28 (NAT gateway resources)
# customer vnet maps to 10.210.0.0/16, endpoint peering via PrivateLink
```

Sanjay Rao: Also recommend autoscaling policy: keep 6 hosts (4 GPUs each) baseline and autoscale to 12 hosts on CPU/GPU queue length. That maps to your 24->48 GPU runway if needed. Need approval for cost impact.

Leah Park: Approve budget to submit soft quota requests. If support needs a business justification for capacity spike, we'll provide the customer PO and expected monthly spend.

Mia Chen: Thanks team. Please proceed with soft quota requests for Azure and open a parallel ticket for GCP fallback. I'll DM legal about the PrivateLink contract clause. :thumbsup:

Omar Patel: Quick note — ensure SNAT observability in Console (per-route egress IP mapping) so we can spot port exhaustion early. I'll add a dashboard.

CloudOps Bot: Marking action items: submit quota requests (Azure + GCP fallback), create PrivateLink service in shared-services, allocate 12 public IPs for NAT, subnet updates. ETA: 48–72hrs for initial replies from cloud providers.

Mia Chen: Great — will follow up after INF-APAC-4892 updates.
